# svc.ms
> Microsoft short-link domain used to redirect users to Microsoft services, documentation, downloads, support, and product resources.

svc.ms primarily serves as a URL shortener and redirect layer for Microsoft properties. Because destination paths often resolve dynamically, the most useful context for LLMs is the canonical Microsoft documentation, support, developer, and product sites commonly reached through Microsoft short links.

## Microsoft Learn
- [Microsoft Learn Home](https://learn.microsoft.com/): Central hub for Microsoft technical documentation, training, and product guidance.
- [Azure Documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/): Product documentation, quickstarts, tutorials, and reference for Azure services.
- [Microsoft 365 Documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/): Admin, deployment, security, and user guidance for Microsoft 365.
- [Power Platform Documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/): Docs for Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, and Copilot Studio.
- [Dynamics 365 Documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/dynamics365/): Product documentation for Dynamics 365 applications and platform capabilities.
- [Windows Documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/): Developer and IT pro documentation for Windows platforms and tools.
- [Microsoft Graph Documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/): API concepts, auth guidance, SDK docs, and REST reference.
- [.NET Documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/): Guides, API browser links, tutorials, and language documentation for .NET.

- [Azure SDK Documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/developer/): Guidance for Azure SDKs, tools, and developer workflows.
- [Microsoft identity platform](https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/identity-platform/): Authentication, authorization, tokens, and app registration guidance.
- [Power Platform API Documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/admin-documentation): Administrative and platform documentation for Power Platform environments.
- [Teams Developer Documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/platform/): Build apps, bots, tabs, and message extensions for Microsoft Teams.
- [Visual Studio Documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/visualstudio/): IDE usage, extensibility, debugging, and development workflow documentation.
